verdict.rationale: The firm lists both O-1 extraordinary-ability visas and EB-1 green cards (including extraordinary ability) among its services, so it offers an EB-1A route alongside the O-1. Its entrepreneur blog covers O-1 strategy for founders but never links the work visa to a green-card continuation. Missing for 10: any documented O-1-to-green-card transition strategy, any mention of EB-2 NIW, guidance on reusing O-1 evidence for an EB-1A petition, and independent or client corroboration.
